subject: Intrinsic functions
notes: LANDED (kb/Work PB123): BindExceptionFileArg now resolves through ctx.Data.FilesByName - the ONE file-name resolution every other site uses, into which BinderDriver merges containers' GLOBAL FDs (13.18.30 / 13.18.27 GR1-2) - instead of scanning the program's OWN FD list, so a contained program naming its container's GLOBAL FD binds (golden pb123_exception_file_global_fd: the never-touched connector answers 15.28.4 r2a's two spaces). SelectName always equals CobolName at construction, so the keyed lookup is equivalent for local files. Both 15.28.3 r1 halves (FD-described, not SD) still enforced on the resolved model. SWEEP (the two-arm-dispatch family's eighth arm): the UNQUALIFIED LINAGE-COUNTER scan in ExpressionBinder.LinageFileOf had the same own-files blind spot - it now scans the VISIBLE set (FilesByName.Values), so a contained program whose only LINAGE file is the container's GLOBAL one resolves the register (same golden), and own-plus-inherited still requires qualification (8.4.3.14 SR3). No other by-name resolution against Data.Files remains (grep: the BinderDriver uses are enumerations).
